ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level ratio consists of approximately 82% low-intensity (black) pixels and 18% high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels concentrated in linear patterns and distal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-contrast light-grey mottling localized at the distal tips; multiple discrete high-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) are mapped across the central and outer 2D coordinates of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Centrally located V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 74 degrees; the vertex of the notch is partially obscured by high-intensity white-water spray pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous upper trailing edge shows irregular low-amplitude pixel variations (serrations), with the highest frequency of peaks detected on the distal halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobe edges follow a broad convex trajectory from the medial notch, transitioning to a sharp concave curvature near the extreme distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of localized, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters at the furthest distal points of the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of distinct, unaligned light-colored linear pixel disruptions crossing the dark pigmentation, particularly prominent on the upper-distal regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant linear high-contrast scarring across both lobes and irregular pixel-edge topography at the tips indicative of prior physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive group of three nearly parallel, high-contrast diagonal linear marks located on the upper quadrant of the right lobe lobe (from image perspective).
